speaker: Patient
text: 40-year-old female. The patient reports a 5-month history of worsening bladder discomfort, which is relieved by voiding. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Since you have pain during intercourse and worsening bladder discomfort that improves after urination, I need to rule out structural issues or infection.
